eval: fresh(0,0,40,0,21); A.do('setuFind'); const id=H.slabs.unstable.find(u=>u.state==='ok'&&u.slab.level==='L1').slab.id; A.do('tpHazard','slab',id); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer',1.2); A.do('hazardGrace',999); A.step(0.5); const h0=G.setu.health; A.step(4); const u=H.slabs.byId.get(id); stop(); ({state:u.state, setuHealth0:+h0.toFixed(1), setuHealth:+G.setu.health.toFixed(1), rays:R()})

name: p4-stress-calls-and-state
eval: go(); fresh(45,0,-14,180,21); A.set('jacket',true); G.flags.jacket=true; A.do('hazardGrace',999); A.do('spawnDogs',4,7,'wander'); A.do('spawnDeranged',9,'wander'); A.do('spawnDrone',{ahead:10,span:6,altitude:6}); A.look(180,-3); A.step(0.6); A.set('invulnerable',true); const rows=[]; for(const a of [0,60,120,200,300]){ A.look(a,-3); A.step(0.1); rows.push(sampleCalls()); } A.look(180,-3); A.step(0.1); stop(); const s=A.state(); ({rows, maxCallsOverTour:maxCalls, triangles:s.render.triangles, awake:s.hazards.awake, detentionsThisRun:s.hazards.detentions, hazardInstancedDrawn:G.scene.children.filter(o=>o.isInstancedMesh&&o.visible&&o.count>0&&/dogs|drones|cameras|crowd|hazard|debris|slab-cracks/.test(o.name)).length})
